title: ceramic cactus
text: ceramic cactus. I purchased 2 of these - the shorter and the taller to go with a display on my patio.  The bottoms are oddly shaped but I found 2 planter bowls that would work and I added some pretty rocks for stability and looks.  I think they are beautiful. Shorter one is pictured on the ground, the taller one is on the stand.  Full disclosure, husband broke one of the tips off of the taller one (a clumsy move),  but it glued back and isn't easily spotted. They are glossy finished, but my neighbor thought they were real cactus from a distance.  I am always looking for something that withstand the heat here and does NOT require water - ever...  these are outside, they are protected from direct sun by my patio.  I have high hopes.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful and I have included some pics that I hope will be helpful to you.
